problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce credential misuse
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns use personalized information to deceive specific individuals, often executives, to gain sensitive access.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Educate high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Apply strict email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF

problems.description: Phishing emails contain attachments with malware that execute upon opening, compromising the victim’s system.
risk_reduction: Block or sandbox email attachments from unknown senders
Keep endpoint antivirus and anti-malware solutions updated
Train users to avoid opening unexpected or suspicious attachments

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets or services due to misconfiguration, leading to data leaks or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration and compliance scanning tools
Enforce least privilege access policies and encryption
Regularly audit cloud resource permissions and exposure

problems.description: Attackers infiltrate or manipulate software or hardware supply chains to introduce malicious code or backdoors before deployment.
risk_reduction: Perform rigorous vendor risk assessments and continuous monitoring
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and code signing
Use zero trust principles for third-party access

problems.description: Use of AI and large language models to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing messages at scale.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-based detection tools for anomalous communications
Enhance user awareness training with examples of AI-generated content
Implement strict email authentication and anomaly detection

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade or subvert machine learning model performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Monitor model behavior for anomalies
Use robust ML architectures resistant to adversarial inputs

problems.description: Advanced ransomware variants using double extortion, fileless techniques, and AI to evade detection and maximize impact.
risk_reduction: Implement robust endpoint detection and response (EDR)
Maintain regular, immutable backups with tested recovery plans
Apply network segmentation and least privilege access
